thread:
casey: starting canary for harbor16b-int4. hit 2 OOMs within first 100 requests using batch=4 and max_new_tokens=256, fragmentation high.
jin: any logs or eviction noise?
casey: saw frequent kv evicts and cuda alloc failures, frag_ratio ~0.68. Some requests fell back to int8.
sophia: initial mitigation: set batch_size=1, prefetch=false, max_new_tokens=120, slot_compaction=true, kv_evict_threshold=0.15. Also enable idle_kv_eviction=45s for session churn.
casey: applied config to canary-1 and rolled.
ops-bot: canary deployed to cluster-canary-1, image=inference:v2.6-harbor-canary
jin: run the lightweight smoke: ./tools/onboard_smoke --model harbor16b:int4 --iters 100 --seq 512
casey: smoke results: OOMs=0, frag_ratio dropped to 0.42, p95 latency +25ms vs fp16, quality delta small (F1 -0.6). throughput lower but stable.
sophia: acceptable short-term. next: schedule kernel audit to remove large temp buffers, try hybrid int4/int8 for attention and norm layers, and run quant-calib with representative prompts to recover F1.
jin: I'll add an onboarding check to run frag stress and assert frag_ratio < 0.6 before promoting.
casey: thanks team — will update model-catalog with the reduced defaults and fallback note.
